Package io.jstach.rainbowgum.spring.boot.spi

@NonNullByDefault package io.jstach.rainbowgum.spring.boot.spi
Spring Rainbow Gum SPI. This SPI does not use the normal service loader but Spring Boot factories loader.

This package lives in its own module (io.jstach.rainbowgum.spring.boot.spi) that is shared by both io.jstach.rainbowgum.spring.boot3 and io.jstach.rainbowgum.spring.boot4: it only depends on org.springframework.core.env.Environment, which is expected to remain stable across Spring Boot major versions, so implementers of SpringRainbowGumServiceProvider never need to change this import when bumping Spring Boot major versions.
